alerts.summary: - Summary A format string injection vulnerability in the applyChatTemplate GraphQL endpoint allows an attacker to read server-side environment variables, cryptographic secrets, and internal module attributes directly from the API response. On default Phoenix installations where authentication is disabled the endpoint is reachable with no credentials. On auth-enabled deployments, any account regardless of privilege level is sufficient to exploit it. - Impact Server filesystem paths, loaded Python module names, and internal configuration constants are fully disclosed, an attacker with network access can read the full server `os.environ` including the admin credentials hardcoded in `phoenix.auth`.
